facts.text: Cedric signed a promissory note owing the party 975 gold for the barrow treasure, payable once the caravans flow again into Brandonsford. The note has been pledged to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda.
facts.uncertain_reason: Unclear whether the party still holds the note or handed it over to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda.

facts.text: The party owes Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment from Cedric's promissory note in return for joining the party.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated the share, the terms or when Malzazarik and Lady Hilda are to be paid.
